summary: Iter 202 — Phase 4 Control Tower (Tour de contrôle dispatch) full backend + frontend validation. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter202_dispatch_control_tower.py with 6 API e2e tests: (1) GET /api/admin/dispatch/overview shape+totals+config block exposes discipline keys + created card-ride visible to admin with payment_method, (2) GET /api/rides?status=pending strips payment_method/payment_status for drivers on non-assigned offers and restores them after /accept, (3) GET/PUT /api/admin/auto-dispatch/config persistence of max_refusals/refusal_window/cb_pct/cb_min (handles {config: ...} wrapper) + reflection in overview.config, (4) suspend→profile.status=suspended+is_online=false + behavior table surfaces suspended driver + reinstate→approved + 404 on unknown id, (5) auto-offline at threshold=2 via POST /api/rides/{id}/decline (1st: went_offline=false, 2nd: went_offline=true and driver flips offline) — config restored to 0 in a finally, (6) role gating: passenger -> 401/403 on overview & driver-behavior. 6/6 pass in ~4s. Frontend Playwright test on https://gojek-clone-41.preview.emergentagent.com /admin/dispatch logged-in admin: data-testids admin-dispatch, total-pending(6), total-online(17), total-alerts(0), cfg-max-refusals, cfg-refusal-window, cfg-cb-pct, cfg-cb-min, cfg-save-btn all present; saved cb_pct=37/cb_min=4 -> 'Réglages enregistrés' toast and values persisted across full page reload; zone-card-Hors zone present with 6 dispatch-ride-* entries, 6 tier-badge-* (Tier 2 🔥) and payment chips (Espèces, CB) rendered per ride; behavior table row + suspend-* button visible. Defaults restored (cb_pct=30, cb_min=3, max_refusals=0). Iter201 regression untouched and still green.
critical_code_review_comments: dispatch_admin.py overview correctly groups pending rides by zone via resolve_zone(lat,lng,address), bucketing demo Paris pickups under 'Hors zone' (expected since seeded zones cover PAP/FDF/Dakar). Payment method is preserved on the ADMIN view (verified: card ride shows payment_method='card' inside overview.zones[].rides[]).

rides.py list_rides correctly strips payment_method/payment_status only when status=='pending' AND driver_id != current driver. Confirmed via API: pending list has no payment_method, /rides/{id} after accept returns payment_method='card'.

rides.py POST /{id}/decline cleanly delegates to record_driver_refusal; reply shape {ok, count, max, went_offline}. went_offline transitions exactly at count>=max_refusals_before_offline (verified count=2 with threshold=2). Sets is_online=false AND clears refusal_log so the counter doesn't immediately retrigger. Good.

auto_dispatch.py GET /config returns {'config': merged_defaults_plus_settings} and PUT returns same wrapper. Make sure frontend services/api.js getConfig/updateConfig consumers parse .config consistently — UI worked, but worth pinning a type to avoid drift.

dispatch_admin.driver_behavior surfaces drivers with any signal (cancel/refusal counts) or status=='suspended'. Drivers with 0 signal correctly omitted to keep the table actionable. flagged = (total >= flag_min AND ratio >= flag_pct). The sort puts flagged + highest CB ratio first — perfect for the operator workflow.

MINOR (non-blocking): suspend_driver/reinstate_driver don't write an audit_log entry — only a notification to the driver. Consider logging actor=admin_id + reason for traceability when CRM/billing teams ask 'who suspended this driver?'.
MINOR: the moderation_state of test2@example.com can accumulate cancel events; my fixture wipes it before/after the run (same approach as iter201) to keep reruns deterministic.
